conditions: Linux GitHub Actions shared runner; veth, no physical NIC throughput claim.
FESS, upstream, HTTP and packet generators share CPUs; measured offered PPS can differ between pairs.
HTTP: 16 closed-loop clients, keep-alive, SQLite batch journal, one nonmatching WAF rule; ClamAV/rate/bots disabled.
Attack: valid IPv4 SYN or empty UDP to protected port 18080 from isolated 192.0.2.3. Legitimate HTTP uses 192.0.2.2.
CIDR cases deny attack source. Rate cases: 10000 PPS and 1000 SYN/s per IP; legitimate 192.0.2.2 explicitly allowed to isolate attack protection.
3 paired repetitions, alternating off/on order. Fresh FESS/SQLite each probe. One second HTTP warmup before measurement.
Counters cover measured flood and HTTP drain, captured before journal flush. Log totals checked after flush. CPU metrics are whole-host CPU and FESS process, not isolated networking CPU.
